runScript delegatecalls into an executor address derived from caller-supplied script data, giving that code full control of this contract's storage and execution before state invariants are re-checked.
runScript resolves the executor through getExecutor before delegatecalling.
runScript decodes the delegatecall return data via returnedDataDecoded.
the _script parameter drives executor resolution and calldata encoding in runScript.
the caller-supplied script bytes are passed to the registry lookup.
runScript stores the resolved executor address in the executorAddr local.
the script-derived executor address is the target of the delegatecall.
runScript builds the calldataArgs blob passed to the delegatecall.
the encoded script/input/blacklist blob is handed to the delegatecall payload.
getExecutor obtains the registry address via getExecutorRegistry.
the executor registry address is read from the kernel state variable, so a replaced kernel redirects script execution.
returnedDataDecoded uses inline assembly returndatacopy to fill the returned buffer.
protectState snapshots the kernel into the preKernel local before execution.
protectState snapshots appId into the preAppId local before execution.
the post-execution require compares kernel against the preKernel snapshot.
the post-execution require compares appId against the preAppId snapshot.
protectState wraps runScript, only detecting kernel/appId tampering after the untrusted delegatecall has already executed.
getAddr performs an external resolver.addr call whose result feeds the publicResolver flow.

normalization_plan.reason: _label is only used to derive the node hash and the subnode label inside _createName; it carries no independent security semantics.
_owner is only forwarded as the new subnode owner argument of ens.setSubnodeOwner inside _createName.
_target is only consumed as the address written by the resolver pointing routine.
the node parameter exists solely as the storage index and ownership key for setAddr and its modifier.
the addr parameter is simply the value stored by setAddr.
the local node is a derived keccak256 value used only within deleteName.
currentOwner is a transient cache of ens.owner used only inside deleteName's branch logic.
executorAddr is the local result of getExecutor and the direct target of the delegatecall in runScript.
calldataArgs is the locally built delegatecall payload in runScript.
the _script parameter is the caller-controlled input that selects the delegatecall target and payload in runScript.
publicResolver is a transient address resolved and immediately reused for the external resolver calls.
_rootNode is validated and stored only within initialize.
preKernel is a temporary snapshot used only for the modifier's post-execution invariant check.
preAppId is a temporary snapshot used only for the modifier's post-execution invariant check.
